newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys Aug diesel from Glencore at +68 cts.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys Aug diesel from Glencore at +68 cts.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded its tender to buy 250,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil from Swiss trader Glencore, a company official said on Friday.
The tender for August 11-12 delivery was awarded at a 68-cent per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo basis.
The official said CPC is expected to issue its next tender on Tuesday for end-August delivery cargoes.

In its last tender, CPC purchased from Shell 235,000 barrels of diesel and 65,000 barrels of jet fuel at premiums of 21.9 cents and 9.4 cents, respectively, both to Singapore quotes on a c-and-f basis for July 27-28 delivery.
